dedupe_keys.name: jaxa g portal earth observation satellite data portal

description: G-Portal is the JAXA portal that offers Earth observation satellite data free of charge for use in many fields. Users can search data without registration, by physical quantity (such as precipitation or ocean colour) or by spacecraft, sensor and processing level, and download it on the web or by SFTP after user registration; a CSW catalogue service is also run. Products include those of the GCOM-C SGLI sensor (version 3 released) and statistical products, and the portal posts operational notices such as a maintenance suspension of the web, SFTP and CSW services on 30 September 2026 and a planned system renewal. Access is free; the terms of use are given on the portal and no licence is named on the pages read. Caveats: the portal offers login and user registration for downloads, product versions change with reprocessing, and the system is being renewed. Coverage is worldwide. It supports hazard exposure analysis with satellite rainfall, land surface temperature, ocean and land products, for example flood and heat assessments for infrastructure; related records are ESA Earth Online, the DLR EOC Geoservice and CNES GEODES.
